# Psalm 46 — The EMET Bible (Literal)
**Translator:** EMET | **Source:** Leningrad Codex (B19A)

---

**1** For-the-choirmaster. Of-the-sons of-Korah. Upon Alamoth. A-song.

**2** God [is] for-us a-refuge and-strength, a-help in-distresses — found exceedingly.

**3** Therefore we-will-not fear when-the-earth changes, and-when-the-mountains totter in-the-heart of-the-seas.

**4** Its-waters roar, they-foam; the-mountains tremble at-its-swelling. Selah.

**5** A-river — its-streams gladden the-city of-God, the-holy [dwelling] of-the-tabernacles of-the-Most-High.

**6** God [is] in-her-midst; she-shall-not be-moved. God helps-her at-the-turning of-the-morning.

**7** Nations rage, kingdoms totter; He-gives His-voice — the-earth melts.

**8** YHWH of-hosts [is] with-us; a-fortress for-us [is] the-God of-Jacob. Selah.

**9** Come, see the-works of-YHWH, who has-set desolations in-the-earth.

**10** He-makes-wars-cease to-the-end of-the-earth; the-bow He-breaks and-cuts the-spear; the-chariots He-burns with-fire.

**11** Be-still and-know that I [am] God; I-will-be-exalted among-the-nations; I-will-be-exalted in-the-earth.

---
## EMET Literal Notes

- **46:11**: 'Be still' (harpu) — literally 'let go, cease striving.' Not contemplative silence but the command to stop fighting. The warrior God says: 'Stop. I've got this.'

— EMET
